relationships.subject: mu-theraphotoxin-Cg4a
relationships.evidence_quote: Cg4a weakly inhibited NaV1.7 peak current with an estimated IC50 of 9.22 ± 0.03 μm

relationships.subject: Cg4a P5W mutant
relationships.evidence_quote: the P5W mutant inhibited hNaV1.7 with an IC50 of 1.75 ± 0.22 μm, making it ~ sixfold more potent than the WT Cg4a

relationships.subject: Cg4a Y11P mutant
relationships.evidence_quote: the mutation Y11P led to a complete loss of activity

key_findings: In silico screening identified Cg4a as a Nav1.7 inhibitor, but it was about 1000-fold weaker than HwTx-IV (IC50 9.22 uM).
V4G and P5W mutations increased Cg4a potency (P5W IC50 1.75 uM), whereas Y11P abolished activity, leading to a refined Nav1.7 pharmacophore filter.
